tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Create a post on any Flomixy channel (Instagram, Threads, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, Telegram, Pinterest, YouTube, WordPress, Bluesky, Google Business Profile; a pin always needs media, accountId is the board, and optional pinTitle/pinLink/pinAltText set the pin title, destination link and alt text

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List posts of the API key's workspace (JSON with items, total, limit, offset; each item carries targets[] with channel, accountId, status and, for a failed target, failureReason and failureReasonCode, and needsReschedule on the post and each target, so the same caption on several networks is one pos

tools.name: get_post

tools.name: get_approval_status
tools.description: Read-only. Approval state of one post: required, approvedAt, approverName and changeRequestNote (the approver's requested changes, so you can fix the draft). The agent cannot decide approval; a human does.

tools.name: list_pending_approvals
tools.description: Read-only. Posts still waiting for a human decision (id, status, scheduledAt, approval). The agent cannot decide approval.

tools.name: get_post_comments
tools.description: Read-only. Comments left during approval of one post (change requests and approval notes), oldest first, so you can see what the reviewer asked for. Not the scheduled first comment. The agent cannot write or reply to review comments.

tools.name: update_post
tools.description: Edit the caption and/or media of a DRAFT (created in the Flomixy app or through the API) or of a post created through the API that is not yet published, and/or set or change the first comment (and its delay) and, on THREADS targets, the topicTag (null removes it) of individual existing targets via t

tools.name: delete_draft
tools.description: Delete a post that is still a draft, whether it was created in the Flomixy app or through the API. tools.name: pause_post
tools.description: Pause a scheduled post: status becomes paused, scheduledAt is kept and nothing is published until resume_post. Only scheduled posts can be paused (publishing/published: 409 POST_NOT_PAUSABLE, not retryable). Requires a key with write scope.

tools.name: resume_post
tools.description: Resume a paused post. Without arguments it keeps the original time; if that time has passed core-api answers 409 SCHEDULED_AT_IN_PAST with a suggested slot, so ask the user for a new time (scheduledAt), or use mode "next_slot". mode "now" publishes immediately and is rejected with 403 unless the key

tools.name: reschedule_post
tools.description: Move a scheduled post (any network) to a new publish time, on every network target that is not yet published. tools.description: Delete a draft, scheduled or paused post that was created through the API, cancelling its pending publish. tools.name: list_media
tools.description: List the media library of the API key's workspace, newest first (id, url, mediaType).

tools.name: get_account_analytics
tools.description: Get analytics metrics for a connected social account. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_posts, get_post, get_approval_status, list_pending_approvals, get_post_comments, delete_draft, list_media, create_upload_link, search_stock_photos, get_best_times, get_post_metrics, list_approvers, get_channel_capabilities, list_rss_feeds, generate_posts_from_rss_item · Private data: create_draft_post, create_post, list_posts, list_hashtag_sets, upload_media, list_media, create_upload_link, list_accounts, list_brands · Public sink: create_draft_post, create_post, list_posts, get_post, get_approval_status, get_post_comments, update_post, delete_draft, pause_post, resume_post, reschedule_post, delete_post, upload_media, create_upload_link, get_best_times, get_post_metrics, list_approvers, get_channel_capabilities, generate_posts_from_rss_item · Destructive: create_post, delete_draft, delete_post, get_channel_capabilities.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
